answer: Agents bind identity to a rolling hash of inference latency distribution sampled each beacon-driven epoch; the network emits a verifiable random seed, agents run a fixed batch, record per-token timing variance, and commit the hash via a threshold signature. A sybil must reproduce the exact latency fingerprint each epoch, forcing full-model inference on identical hardware and costing the attacker the same compute budget as honest participation; the echo of timing noise hits a nadir only on matching silicon, and a sparrow of deviation flags the fake.
